svg.title: RopeAndCacheQkvKernel and RotateHead
svg.text: RopeAndCacheQkvKernel: one block of 64 threads per (row, slot), 16 slots per row
one row of qkv: 12 query heads, 2 key heads, 2 value heads, head_dim = 128; blockIdx.x = row × 16 + slot
__syncthreads(), then StoreHead writes staged (BF16 by default) to
cache.keys / cache.values at row cache_rows[row], head slot − 12 / − 14
RotateHead on k0 of " is" at position 4 (layer 0): thread i turns the pair (in[i], in[i + 64])
Gray: (a, b) = (in[i], in[i + 64]); amber: (a cos − b sin, b cos + a sin).
Pair 0 turns 4 rad; the last pairs, which hold the largest values, barely move.
blockIdx.x gives the row and the slot; in points at that head's 128 values
a query slot rotates into q and is done
a key slot rotates into staged, a value slot copies; after the barrier StoreHead writes the cache row
